metadata.title: Link Guideline to Steps
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Update step JSON files to add a newly created guideline to their userGuidelines array. Use after creating a guideline that should be referenced by existing steps.

output.description: Updated step JSON files with new userGuidelines entries

prerequisites: Guideline file must exist (created in previous step)
Guideline file path known (stored in memory.json)
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: get guideline info → scan steps → analyze content → Q&A confirm → update files → verify
Use Q&A Session component to confirm which steps to link
Always preserve existing userGuidelines entries (append only)
Skip steps that already reference the guideline (idempotent)
Use consistent path format (forward slashes, relative to project root)

update: Step JSON files that user confirms

tools: read_file - Read memory and step JSON files for content analysis
list_dir - List all step categories and files
grep - Search step content for keyword matches
search_replace - Update JSON files with new guideline references
bestPractices: Validate guideline file exists before adding references
Skip steps that already reference the guideline
Preserve JSON formatting when updating files
Document which steps were/weren't updated and why
Provide clear reasoning for why each step is considered relevant

substeps.name: Get guideline info from memory
substeps.description: Retrieve the guideline file path and context from previous step
actions: Read memory.json to get guidelineFilePath from previous step
Verify the guideline file exists at the path
Extract guideline purpose and topic for relevance matching
Check if relatedSteps parameter was provided

substeps.name: Identify target steps
substeps.description: Analyze step JSON files to find relevant steps, then confirm with user
actions: Scan all step JSON files in .processes/steps/ (all categories)
Read and analyze each step's content to determine relevance:
- Check metadata.purposeAndUsage - does it relate to the guideline topic?
- Check guidance.specificActions - would this guideline help?
- Check substeps descriptions - do they involve tasks the guideline addresses?
Compile list of relevant steps with reasoning for each
If relatedSteps parameter provided, include those as additional suggestions
Use Q&A Session component to present discovered steps and get user confirmation

substeps.name: Update step JSON files
substeps.description: Add the guideline path to confirmed steps' userGuidelines array
actions: For each confirmed step:
- Read the step JSON file
- Check if guidance.userGuidelines array exists (create if missing)
- Check if guideline path already present (skip if yes)
- Append the guideline path to the array
- Write the updated JSON file
Track which files were modified vs skipped

substeps.name: Verify and document
substeps.description: Verify updates were applied correctly and document changes
actions: For each modified file, verify the guideline is in userGuidelines
Update memory.json with: stepsUpdated, stepsSkipped, guidelineLinked
Log the changes in log.json

flow.description: Linear flow with Q&A decision point: get guideline info → scan and analyze steps → Q&A confirm targets → update files → verify and document

fields: Information Produced: stepsUpdated (array of paths), stepsSkipped (with reasons)
guidelineLinked: Path to the guideline that was added
